themes.$note: Three real, selectable site themes confirmed by (1) a literal 3-dot theme-switcher control in the Home page nav (node 79:2080/79:1902 cluster) and (2) each site section rendering a genuinely different background. 'dark' is the only one bound to a Figma Variable (the announcement strip uses primary/base); 'gold' and 'forest' are raw hardcoded hex in Figma, not tokenized there. Section names in Figma are misleading: both 'gold' and 'forest' are labeled 'Light Mode' even though 'forest' has a dark background — treat the names below as ours, not Figma's.
themes.$note2: Each theme has TWO backgrounds: the page `background` and a distinct, separately-colored `accentStripe` used by the announcement bar (and, confirmed on gold, the ProductGallery tile surface as `gallerySurface`). Originally missed because only the hero's inner content was checked, not the outer page wrapper — background/accentStripe were conflated into one color per theme until the Product Page pull surfaced the split.
